name: Tsukiakari no Raspberry ~Tsun★Dere II~
original_name: 月明りのラズベリィ～つん★デれII～
source:
Himezaki Orie is still anxious about her first love with new teacher. She gets a new best friend and together with it a sweet, fully and slightly painful feeling. And her love story continues.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
姬崎织绘仍为自己与新任教师的初恋而感到不安。她结识了一名新的挚友，同时体会到一种甜蜜、充实又略带痛楚的感情。她的恋爱故事仍在继续。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
